back_story: Ocean Drive is the beating heart of Vice City — a strip of Art Deco hotels, neon signs and palm shadows where every night looks like the cover of a summer album. Convertibles cruise the wet asphalt, radios blast, and the pink dusk never quite ends. In 1986 this was the most famous street in Miami, and in Vice City it was the one you drove to feel alive.
